codemirror.js — ONE esbuild ESM bundle (deduped; separate CDN imports load
two @codemirror/state copies and CM6 refuses to run). Served by the
gateway at /vendor/codemirror.js.

├── @codemirror/language@6.13.1
├── @codemirror/state@6.7.6
├── @codemirror/theme-one-dark@6.1.3
├── @codemirror/view@6.43.14
└── codemirror@6.0.2

entry.js:
  export { EditorView, basicSetup, minimalSetup } from "codemirror";
  export { keymap, placeholder } from "@codemirror/view";
  export { Prec } from "@codemirror/state";
  export { StreamLanguage } from "@codemirror/language";
  export { oneDark } from "@codemirror/theme-one-dark";
build: npx esbuild entry.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=codemirror.js
